verdict: Cinematic AI-builder ad: prompt -> streaming code -> generated app on device mockups (frames 612-1060).
Dark blue glow palette for the 'generation' chapter, off-white for explanation, sky footage for brand moments.
Editing shown with a blue selection box and property panel while the rest stays sharp (frames 1636-1836).
Skeleton loader morphing into the real page and blur-to-sharp reveal are the signature transitions (frames 1060-1300).
Slow pacing: avg 219 frames per shot, too slow for 30 s but the 3-beat prompt/generate/result grammar is reusable.
